careerai.comment: Local careerai-mcp server. Install: `cargo install --git https://github.com/justdoGIT/career-ai careerai-mcp` (or grab a prebuilt binary from the GitHub Releases page once tagged). The plugin's slash commands and skills route most calls through this server.

linkedin-jobs.comment: Default LinkedIn discovery via RapidAPI's LinkedIn Data API. ToS-clean (no scraping). Free tier exists. Not on PyPI under this name as of 2026-04-27, so we install directly from the upstream Git repo via uvx. Set LINKEDIN_RAPIDAPI_KEY to enable; the server is harmless without a key but discovery calls will fail.

linkedin-browser.comment: Opt-in: browser-based LinkedIn scraper. Violates LinkedIn User Agreement section 8.2 (no automated access). Disabled by default. Installed from the upstream Git repo via uvx (not on PyPI). Flip `disabled` to false at your own risk; rate caps and cookie-jar rotation in careerai-submit still apply.
